course.title: Khaemenes Higher Learning Calculus III · Multivariable & Vector Calculus
course.assessment_history_policy: New attempts write to learner-scoped v2 history; legacy v1 history is preserved and never silently reassigned.
course.audience: College-level and advanced independent learners who have completed Calculus II or demonstrated equivalent mastery
course.prerequisite: Calculus II or equivalent mastery of single-variable differentiation, integration, sequences/series, parametric curves, polar coordinates and mathematical communication
course.credit_guidance: Designed as a rigorous third-semester college calculus course; institutional credit decisions remain with the receiving institution.
